answer: WNT2+ and PEAR1+ prenatal fibroblasts express genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (e.g. IL1R1) and collagen deposition (e.g. POSTN). Additionally, late gestation WNT2+ fibroblasts upregulate extracellular matrix/collagen deposition genes (e.g. COL1A1), while early WNT2+ fibroblasts have DEGs involved in cellular growth and differentiation (e.g. SFRP1).
support_quote: Notably, WNT2 + and PEAR1 + prenatal fibroblasts expressed several genes involved in cellular senescence (CDKN1A), cytokine pathways (for example, IL1R1) and collagen deposition (for example, POSTN) (Fig. 3a,b), which are highly expressed in pathogenic fibroblasts of fibrotic skin disorders 53 .
